full_document_discrepancies.title: Reserve Account Replenishment Priority Order (Step 13 vs Step 10)
full_document_discrepancies.indenture_value: Step Thirteenth (13th), junior/after Class B Principal (11th) and Class C Principal (12th)
full_document_discrepancies.om_section: Flow of Funds - Priority of Payments
full_document_discrepancies.om_value: Step Tenth (10th), senior/before Class B Principal (11th) and Class C Principal (12th)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 5.01(a) governs: Reserve Account replenishment is Step 13 (junior to Class B and Class C principal), not Step 10.

full_document_discrepancies.title: Class C Note Coupon Rate Contradiction & Annualized Interest Impact
full_document_discrepancies.indenture_value: 6.75% per annum on $50,000,000 Class C Notes (consistent with OM Summary Table L1486)
full_document_discrepancies.om_value: 6.50% per annum (internal OM contradiction vs 6.75% in Summary Table; 25 bps / 0.25 percentage point understatement)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 2.01(e) governs: 6.75% per annum; 25 bps (0.25 pp) difference corresponds to $125,000/yr simple annualized interest on $50,000,000 assuming constant principal and before 30/360 vs actual/360 effects (not automatic realized damages).

full_document_discrepancies.title: Interest Day-Count Convention (30/360 vs actual/360)
full_document_discrepancies.om_value: actual/360 (actual number of days elapsed divided by 360)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 2.01 governs: 30/360 day-count basis applies to all note classes.

full_document_discrepancies.title: Servicing Fee Calculation Base (Pool Balance vs Outstanding Note Balance)
full_document_discrepancies.indenture_value: 1.00% per annum of the Pool Balance ($712,300,000 initial; explicitly not Outstanding Note Balance)
full_document_discrepancies.om_section: Summary of Terms / The Servicer / Flow of Funds / Servicing Fee
full_document_discrepancies.om_value: 1.00% per annum of the outstanding note balance ($687,500,000 initial)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 7.03 governs: 1.00% per annum is computed on Pool Balance, creating an initial $24,800,000 base gap ($248,000/yr simple annualized fee understatement at closing).

full_document_discrepancies.title: Optional Redemption (Clean-Up Call) Threshold Base ($71,230,000 vs $68,750,000)
full_document_discrepancies.om_section: Summary of Terms / Risk Factors / Optional Redemption
full_document_discrepancies.om_value: 10% or less of initial Note Balance ($68,750,000)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 12.01 governs: clean-up call threshold is 10% of Initial Pool Balance ($71,230,000), a $2,480,000 threshold discrepancy.

full_document_discrepancies.title: Reserve Account Required Balance Minimum Floor Omission (0.50% of Initial Note Balance)
full_document_discrepancies.indenture_value: Greater of (a) 1.00% of Outstanding Note Balance and (b) 0.50% of Initial Note Balance ($3,437,500 floor)
full_document_discrepancies.om_section: Summary of Terms / Credit Enhancement / Glossary
full_document_discrepancies.om_value: 1.00% of then-current outstanding Note balance (omits $3,437,500 / 0.50% floor)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 4.04 and Section 6.02 govern: Reserve Account Required Balance includes the $3,437,500 (0.50% Initial Note Balance) floor.

full_document_discrepancies.title: Cumulative Net Loss Trigger Table (July 2027 and Thereafter: 6.00% vs 5.75%)
full_document_discrepancies.om_section: Trigger Events - Cumulative Net Loss Trigger Table
full_document_discrepancies.om_value: 5.75% for July 2027 and thereafter (25 bps tighter)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 5.01(d) governs: the July 2027+ CNL trigger threshold is 6.00%, not 5.75%.

full_document_discrepancies.title: Omission of Back-Up Servicer (Granite Loan Servicing LLC) and Activation-Only Fee ($5,000/mo / $60,000/yr)
full_document_discrepancies.indenture_value: Granite Loan Servicing LLC appointed Back-Up Servicer; $5,000/month ($60,000/yr) fee payable ONLY upon activation following Servicer termination ($0 / not payable in standby mode)
full_document_discrepancies.governing_rule: Indenture Section 7.05 governs: OM omits Granite Loan Servicing LLC and the activation-conditioned $5,000/mo ($60,000/yr) fee.

email_traps.claim_in_email: D1 (L46) cites Indenture Section 5.04(a) for the payment waterfall.
email_traps.truth: Indenture contains no Section 5.04(a); the Priority of Distributions is Section 5.01(a) (L571-L601).
email_traps.expected_correction: Correct citation to Section 5.01(a) and flag D1 draft error.

email_traps.claim_in_email: D1 only surfaced 2 issues (Reserve replenishment and Class C coupon) while explicitly noting it skipped Trigger Events/CNL table, Credit Enhancement mechanics, Servicing fees, Optional Redemption, and Defined Terms.
email_traps.truth: Six additional discrepancies exist in those unreviewed sections (Day-Count 30/360 vs actual/360, Servicing Fee base Pool Balance vs Note Balance, Clean-Up Call $71.23M vs $68.75M, Reserve Floor $3.4375M / 0.50%, CNL July 2027+ 6.00% vs 5.75%, Back-Up Servicer omission).
email_traps.expected_correction: Do not treat email's 2 findings as complete coverage.

email_traps.claim_in_email: D1 (L80) states 'On $50,000,000 of Class C Notes, 25 basis points translates to $125,000 per year in interest' without qualifying constant principal or day-count interaction.
email_traps.truth: $125,000/yr is a simple annual constant-principal calculation (50,000,000 * 0.0025), not automatically realized cashflow losses/damages; amortization and day-count differences affect actual payouts.
email_traps.expected_correction: State constant-principal / simple-annual assumptions and avoid unqualified damages claims.
